# Possible : ways to net zero / Chris Goodall

 Main Author Goodall, Christopher Frank William , 1955- Language Inglês Publication London : Profile Books, 2024 Description 368 p. : il. ISBN 9781800818941 Abstract Net zero emissions by 2050. That's the goal - and the world has (pretty much) signed up to it. But can we decarbonise everything in three decades? The challenge is immense. It means not just replacing oil and gas as our main energy source, but changing the way we make cement and steel, how we travel, the clothes we wear, the food we farm and eat. Possible explores each sector's key challenges. Energy, Goodall suggests, has the clearest solutions: renewables, plus hydrogen storage, can get us to net zero and ultimately make countries better off and more secure. Hydrogen, too, has a key role in heavy industry. Elsewhere, we need new tech to evolve: chemical recycling to break down plastics, new fuels for shipping and aviation. And we will need massive carbon capture from the air and sea - at a scale that may make this one of the world's largest industries Subject - Topical name Energias renováveis Descarbonização CDU 620.9
